hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Restraints and whip checks on iron; exclusion zone around pressurized lines.

name: Pressure transducers (missile)
function: The pressure transducers on the discharge header that feed the data van and the pump kickout logic.

tabs.overview: Two or more for redundancy; the reading is the pump-side treating pressure that the kickout compares against its setting.
tabs.engineering: Rated fittings; calibration checked before the job.
tabs.safety: A failed transducer is replaced with the pumps off and the header bled.
tabs.evidence: Frac manifold missile patent (S31), electric fleet article (S37), fracturing design evolution article (S36), EIA regions (S38), field practice (S9). Photographs read for proportion only.
